choices.de: Scheren Sie auch Schafe, Herr Dixon?

why.en: After do, the verb has no -s: do you clip …?
why.sl: Za do glagol nima -s: do you clip …?
why.it: Dopo do il verbo non ha la -s: do you clip …?
why.de: Nach do hat das Verb kein -s: do you clip …?

reply.en: Clips? Again, properly.
reply.sl: Clips? Še enkrat, pravilno.
reply.it: Clips? Di nuovo, per bene.
reply.de: Clips? Noch mal, richtig.

lines.en: When I was young, I won the wrestling at Grasmere.
lines.sl: Ko sem bil mlad, sem zmagal v rokoborbi v Grasmeru.
lines.it: Da giovane ho vinto la lotta a Grasmere.
lines.de: Als ich jung war, habe ich das Ringen in Grasmere gewonnen.

reply.en: Aye. Still am. Feel that arm!
reply.sl: Ja. Še vedno sem. Potipaj to roko!
reply.it: Sì. Lo sono ancora. Senti questo braccio!
reply.de: Ja. Bin ich immer noch. Fühl mal den Arm!

why.en: With you, the past of be is were: were you strong? Was is for I, he, she and it.
why.sl: Z you je pretekli čas od be were: were you strong? Was je za I, he, she in it.
why.it: Con you il passato di be è were: were you strong? Was è per I, he, she e it.
why.de: Mit you heißt die Vergangenheit von be were: were you strong? Was ist für I, he, she und it.

reply.en: Was you? Hmph. It's right, or it isn't.
reply.sl: Was you? Hm. Je prav ali pa ni.
reply.it: Was you? Mah. O è giusto o non lo è.
reply.de: Was you? Hmpf. Es ist richtig, oder es ist es nicht.
